info.title: GoCab API
info.description: Cab booking platform – rides, realtime tracking, payments, wallet, promos, reviews and receipts.

post.description: Verify a token (GoCab JWT or Supabase access token) and return the user + a GoCab token.

get.description: Fare estimate for every vehicle class (distance/time from Google Directions or OSRM).
Ride history for the current rider or driver (newest first).
Lightweight polling endpoint (the websocket pushes the same info in realtime).

post.description: REST alternative to sending {"type":"location"} over the driver websocket.

get.description: Open ride requests near the driver that they haven't declined.
Online drivers around a point (shown as cars on the rider's map).
Earnings and trip stats for the driver dashboard.

post.description: Create a Stripe PaymentIntent for a completed card ride.
Called by the frontend after Stripe.js confirms; double-checks status with Stripe.
Stripe webhook – verifies the Stripe-Signature header and fulfils payments.
Top up the wallet via Stripe (or instantly in demo mode). 5% cashback on ₹500+.
Rider rates driver or driver rates rider after a completed ride.

get.description: Aggregated rating (average, count, star distribution) + latest reviews.
